title: Rosalind and the Border
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Casper Thackeray, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
